name: DSH Superagent
tagline: A coding agent that picks up work from your team chats and delivers pull requests without being asked.
sentence: Monitors your GitHub project for coding requests from authorized people and works them in parallel, returning pull requests without you coordinating each one.

board.say: Your coding agent only works when you ask it, one task at a time, and stops the moment you walk away.
Someone posts a coding request in a GitHub conversation on your project.
A bug report, a feature request, or a question posted in a GitHub thread by an authorized team member.
The agent picks up the request, works it in its own session, and replies with a pull request.
steps: A router picks up the message, checks whether the sender is authorized, and creates a work item
A worker session clones the project into its own directory and codes the fix or feature
The agent replies in the original conversation with a pull request or an answer
A web panel flags anything that needs your review

board.say: Pull requests delivered while you do other things, and a panel showing only the items that need your decision.

outputs.eg: A team member reports a bug in a GitHub thread; the agent opens a pull request with the fix and replies with a link
A web dashboard shows 3 items needing your approval and 7 completed tasks

before: You assign each bug or task to the agent by hand, one at a time, and wait for it to finish
Messages asking for code fixes pile up until someone acts on them
after: The agent picks up authorized requests from your team and works them in parallel
A web panel shows only the items that need your decision - everything else is handled
uses_note: DSH Superagent is 6 days old. The only known user is DeepSeek's own engineering team, who built this from their daily workflow.

coverage.title: DeepSeek team open-sources proactive coding agent research prototype

steps: Ask the agent: 'Read SETUP.md and set up dsh-superagent with me' - it walks you through connecting to a GitHub project
try.paste:
/skillspector https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype
Then: Clone the repo, install DeepSeek Harness, and ask the agent to read SETUP.md and set up the superagent with you. 10 minutes.

footprint.runs_on: Any machine that runs Node.js and pnpm. Requires DeepSeek Harness (a separate install from deepseek.com/en/harness).

best_for: Teams that want coding tasks handled automatically from GitHub conversations
Developers who already use DeepSeek Harness and want it to work without being asked
skip_if: You don't write code or manage a codebase
You need a production-ready agent - this is a research prototype with known bugs
You're not comfortable giving an agent broad permissions on your machine

alternatives.name: Claude Code
alternatives.line: Anthropic's coding agent - you run it yourself, one task at a time, from your terminal

alternatives.name: T3 Code
alternatives.line: A control panel for multiple coding agents - you still start each task, but you can manage them from your phone

watch: **Single-commit code drop with 20K stars.** The entire codebase was published in one commit with zero listed contributors. This is common for initial open-source releases from major companies, but means the commit history is opaque.
**Research prototype, not production-ready.** DeepSeek says it may contain bugs, and the published code doesn't match their internal version.
**Broad permissions.** The agent runs with full access to your operating system user's files and commands.
**Very early.** The only known user is DeepSeek's own team. Independent adoption has not been reported.
